answer: Bandwidth attestation: every identity must periodically serve a randomly audited data chunk to a network-selected verifier, proving real dedicated upstream capacity. Each round has a short horizon; identities that miss it drop from the registry until they pass again. A clone is cheap, but a farmer must rent genuine bandwidth per fake identity, recurring each cycle. Clones sharing one exit behave like wind through an inlet: a light zephyr passes, but funneled connections throttle and expose the shared origin.
